trial_court: Family Court, Matrimonial Case No. 1226 of 2016
case_name: Saurabh Kumar Sanjay @ Saurabh Kumar vs The State Of Bihar

parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Bihar, Smt. Priyanka Kumari @ Dolly (wife)

facts_of_case: Petitioner sought condonation of delay in filing revision application; trial court passed interim order for maintenance and cost of litigation.

legal_principles.principle: The reasons shown are sufficient to condone the delay.
legal_principles.held: Considering that the impugned order is dated 17.12.2019 passed by learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Patna in Matrimonial Case No. 1226 of 2016 and only three months thereafter the corona period begun, this Court is of the considered opinion that the reasons shown are sufficient to condone the delay.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking condonation of delay to show sufficient reasons.

outcome.final_order: Delay condoned, permission to convert application into civil miscellaneous application under Article 227 of the Constitution of India at the risk of the petitioner.

use_for_drafting: condoning delay in filing revision application
